models.variant_description: Individual standard AA BK-3MCC cell. The opened manual covers retail multipacks BK-3MCC/2, BK-3MCC/4 and BK-3MCC/8; package quantity is not an electrically assembled pack. Other suffixes are not assumed equivalent.
models.capacity_test_conditions: Minimum capacity is stated against JIS C 8708:2007 section 7.2.1 charge/discharge conditions. The opened manual does not reproduce the numerical protocol.
models.maintenance_notes: Use an eneloop-series charger compatible with this cell size and follow its instructions. Protect cells against short circuits when storing or carrying them. This source summary does not define a maintenance interval.

/variant_description.observation: BK-3MCC/2, BK-3MCC/4 and BK-3MCC/8 are retail packages of individual AA cells.
